references.text: The original Sabbath command given at Sinai, which Deuteronomy 5:12 refers back to with the words 'as the Lord your God has commanded you'
The Sabbath as a sign between God and Israel, emphasizing the importance of keeping the Sabbath day holy
Repeats the command to keep the Sabbaths holy as part of the law of holiness
The Sabbath mentioned as the first of the Lord's feasts, a holy convocation
Jeremiah's warning to keep the Sabbath day holy and not carry burdens on that day
Nehemiah restores Sabbath observance in Jerusalem after the exile
Jesus teaches about the true meaning of the Sabbath and declares himself Lord of the Sabbath
Jesus says the Sabbath was made for man, and that the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath
Jesus heals on the Sabbath and defends his action against criticism
There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God, as the fulfillment of the Sabbath command
